summary: None of the nine documents is the 2005 permission S/03404/05/FUL for 115 Vicarage Road. Eight of them are the complete file for a NEIGHBOUR-STREET precedent: 95 Vicarage Road, Kings Heath, B14 7QG, application 2020/06341/PA ("Retention of single storey rear extension and associated remedial works", i.e. retrospective), granted 11 December 2020. That file comprises the decision notice, officer's delegated report, the scanned householder application form (agent: Mr Hanif Ghumra, 733 Walsall Road, Great Barr), drawings P001/P001 Rev A (proposed ground-floor + roof plans) and P002/P002 Rev A (proposed elevations), and 1:500 block / 1:1250 location plans. The ninth document (00000069-attachment.pdf) is a Tide bank payment confirmation dated 22 Apr 2026 from CANDOR DEVOIR LTD paying £1,500.00 to "Design & plan construction ltd", reference "Conversion Design" — i.e. Mo's own payment to the architect, not a planning document. Key extracted numbers for the 95 Vicarage Road extension: described on the application form as a "3.5M SINGLE STOREY REAR EXTENSION. ORANGERY" (work started ~1/5/19-20, not completed at submission); the only written dimensions on any drawing are two stacked "1500" annotations on the P002 left side elevation (1500mm brick plinth + 1500mm glazing = c.3.0m to flat-roof deck, with a low pitched glass-roof lantern above); drawings are 1:100 @ A3 with a 0-5m scale bar, so all other dimensions (depth scales to c.3.5-3.8m, full rear width) must be scaled off the sheet. The officer's report records that the extension FAILED the 45-Degree Code (vs No.99's rear patio doors) and failed the numerical guidelines, but was approved because the offending section is mainly glass (fully glazed roof secured by condition, obscure glazing to side facing No.93, glazed roof to be completed within 6 months), a previous conservatory of similar scale existed in the same location, and boundary fencing mitigated impact. The 2005 documents for 115 Vicarage Road (with the 3600mm Catnic lintel / 3300mm span section) are NOT in this batch.

facts.detail: 'PROPOSED ELEVATIONS' Drawing No P002 Rev A, Scale 1:100 @ A3, Drawn IV, Checked HG, Date 05-11-2020, for 95 Vicarage Road. Shows Proposed Rear Elevation, Proposed Left Side Elevation, Proposed Right Side Elevation. The ONLY written dimensions on the sheet are on the Left Side Elevation: two stacked dimensions of '1500' and '1500' (mm) - lower 1500 = brick plinth wall, upper 1500 = glazing band - giving c.3.0m from ground to the flat-roof/eaves line of the extension, with a shallow pitched 'GLASS ROOF' lantern above (glass roof labelled on rear, left and right elevations). Extension shown with brick piers/plinth, full-height glazing panels, and bi-fold door sets on the rear elevation. Eaves/ridge heights of the main house are NOT dimensioned; extension total height, depth and width would need scaling (extension depth scales to c.3.5m, ridge of glass lantern scales to c.3.4-3.5m).

Delegated date 10/12/2020; Accepted 12/08/2020; Target 11/12/2020; Application type Householder; Ward Brandwood & King's Heath; Officer Leah Russell. Proposal: retention of single storey rear extension (already complete); follows enforcement case 2019/1762/ENF for an unauthorised rear extension. Amended plans sought to make extension roof fully glazed to overcome 45 Degree Code issues. Site: semi-detached, hipped roof, previously extended with first floor side and rear extensions and single storey rear extensions. Attached neighbour No.93 has ground floor patio doors serving habitable room nearest the site; adjacent No.99 has a door to a lean-to nearest the site, nearest habitable window is a rear kitchen window. Planning history for 95: 1999/03206/PA lounge/kitchen/WC/bedroom extension approved 18/08/1999; 1999/13206/PA canopy across front 05/05/2000; 2006/06910/PA conservatory approved 11/12/2006; 2016/04560/PA two storey side extension, first floor rear extension, single storey front extension and conservatory approved 12/07/2016. Assessment: Complies with 45 Degree Code? NO. Complies with numerical guidelines? NO. Justification: extension technically breaches 45 Degree Code from rear patio doors of No.99, but the code allows mainly-glass structures; section adjacent No.93 has side glazing above fence line, large bi-fold doors, and (amended) fully glazed roof; close-boarded fence mitigates; previous conservatory of similar scale in same location. Side windows fail the 5m-per-storey separation distance for windows overlooking private amenity space - obscure glazing condition imposed. No neighbour responses received. No CIL. Policy: BDP 2017, Places for Living SPG 2001, 45 Degree Code SPG 2006, Extending Your Home SPD 2007, NPPF, UDP 2005 saved policies. Approved subject to same 3 conditions as decision notice.
facts.value: Approved despite failing 45 Degree Code and numerical guidelines (glass structure exception)
